_comment: Crop boxes for the figures of ADR chapter 5.2, measured from 70 dpi renders of the UNECE English edition Volume II (adr2.pdf, sha256-pinned in backend/seed/dg/sources.json) by the measurement pass of scripts/extract_adr_label_models.py and by scripts/measure_figure_crops.py. Pages are 1-based; rects are points in page space. Where a model prints two specimen variants, the box holds the first (topmost). Valid for this one edition file only - a new edition is re-measured, never reused. The label table pages print the table content rotated 90 degrees; rotate_clockwise_degrees restores the labels upright after cropping, and a crop from an upright page overrides it with its own. MP is the environmentally hazardous substance mark of Figure 5.2.1.8.3; its printed figure carries dimension annotations along the lower edges, and the pinned 'diamond' geometry (center and half-diagonal, page points, measured like the crop box) masks everything outside the mark's own boundary. BATTERY_SYMBOL is only the symbol of Figure 5.2.1.9.2 - the group of batteries with one damaged and emitting flame - and not the whole mark: the printed mark is wrapped in dimension annotations that abut its hatched edging, and its rectangle, its 5 mm red hatching and the place for the UN number(s) are given by the provision in words, so the sheet builds the frame from those values and puts this symbol in it. ORIENTATION is Figure 5.2.1.10.1.2, the framed one of the two arrow figures printed side by side; 5.2.1.10.1 calls the rectangular border optional, and the captions were matched to the drawings by their own x position, because the two figures are identical apart from that border.
